verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no official cookbook, recipe repository, or worked example of a real end-to-end task such as RAG, agents, or fine-tuning. The closest items are a desktop-setup how-to ([llama-docs-9]) and a mention of passing a --model-id parameter to an unnamed script ([llama-docs-16]). Neither shows a multi-step task a developer could adapt, and the docs surface is also SSO-gated ([llama-supp-docs-gated]).

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
